executive_summary.notes: All four HT-087 acceptance criteria are satisfied. Two non-blocking findings logged: a silent UX gap in Auto-Layout (view-mode no-op without feedback) and a minor markdown rendering gap (blockquote syntax not rendered as <blockquote>). No data-loss, auth, or functional failures observed.

evidence: AUTO-LAYOUT button present in toolbar with aria-description='Rearrange nodes using auto-layout'
In EDIT mode: clicking AUTO-LAYOUT visibly repositioned all canvas nodes (position set changed from x:380,y:320 to x:442,y:523 for one node; all other nodes shifted proportionally)
Positions persisted after F5 reload
Screenshot: doc/bugs/ht087-autolayout-before.png (before), doc/bugs/ht087-autolayout-after-edit-mode.png (after)

findings.title: Auto-Layout button silently inactive in view mode — no disabled state or feedback
findings.detail: When the canvas is in VIEW mode, clicking AUTO-LAYOUT does nothing and gives no feedback (toast, disabled state, or tooltip). Users expect either the button to be disabled/greyed-out or a toast saying 'Switch to Edit mode first'. The feature itself works correctly once in EDIT mode.

evidence: Read mode renders H1 (#), H2 (##), **bold**, `inline code`, and [url](text) links as proper HTML elements (confirmed via a11y tree: heading level=1, heading level=2, StaticText segments for bold, link elements)
Edit mode shows raw textarea with 'Markdown supported.' hint text
DOMPurify loaded and active (dompurify.mjs confirmed in network resources)
XSS payload (<script>alert(1)</script>) was sanitized — no script executed
Screenshot: doc/bugs/ht087-markdown-readmode.png

findings.title: Markdown blockquote syntax '> text' not rendered as <blockquote> HTML
findings.detail: In device notes read mode, lines starting with '> ' are rendered as literal text '> Do not power cycle...' rather than as an HTML <blockquote> element. All other CommonMark syntax (headings, bold, inline code, links) renders correctly. Likely a NiceGUI/mistune markdown library limitation — blockquote rendering may not be enabled in the current markdown configuration.
findings.repro: 1. Open device detail panel. 2. Click Edit Notes. 3. Enter '> Do **not** power cycle without prior snapshot.' 4. Save. 5. Observe Notes in read mode — blockquote is shown as literal '> Do not...' text.

All 7 required columns confirmed in CSV_COLUMNS constant: ['Name', 'Status', 'Type', 'IP', 'MAC', 'Location', 'Notes']

HT075-DeviceLive-Z row verified: name='HT075-DeviceLive-Z', status='Active', type='NAS', ip='10.75.1.3', notes present with markdown content

prioritized_issues.title: Auto-Layout button silently inactive in view mode with no user feedback
prioritized_issues.action: Click AUTO-LAYOUT button while canvas is in view mode
prioritized_issues.steps_to_reproduce: 1. Navigate to /topology. 2. Verify canvas is in view mode (EDIT button visible, not active). 3. Click AUTO-LAYOUT. 4. Observe: nothing happens, no toast, no disabled state.
prioritized_issues.expected: Button is visually disabled OR a toast appears: 'Switch to Edit mode to use Auto-Layout'
prioritized_issues.actual: Button appears fully clickable but click produces no action or feedback

prioritized_issues.title: Markdown blockquote (> text) renders as literal text instead of <blockquote>
prioritized_issues.action: Save Notes with '> blockquote text', view in read mode
prioritized_issues.steps_to_reproduce: 1. Open device with IP. 2. Edit Notes. 3. Enter '> Do **not** power cycle without prior snapshot.' 4. Save Notes. 5. View Notes in read mode.
prioritized_issues.expected: Line renders as HTML blockquote element (indented, styled)
prioritized_issues.actual: Renders as literal '> Do not power cycle without prior snapshot.' text
